answer: Each epoch auctions 100 admission slots for copper. The clearing price rises with demand, so 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times. At 40 copper a slot, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 copper against a 12,000 POA pool: a guaranteed loss. Admission runs at glacier pace, so no flood of fresh identities arrives at once. Winners get a jade seal for one epoch; proceeds burn, so an honest agent pays once, keeps a full share, and is never diluted.
